niche: a San Joaquin Valley irrigation district's 2027 season order with its supplying project, set at the 24th of 30 replayed weather seasons through a daily root-zone water balance on each field of the coming season's requests, every replay started from each field's root zone at the end of 31 January 2027, after a wet 2025-26 winter, a 2026 season the drip, micro-sprinkler and sprinkler fields ran at a working deficit, and the driest October to January in the district's weather record
answer: Kestrel Bend Irrigation District should order 215,000 acre-feet from the Tolan Valley Project for the 2027 season. That is the smallest whole number of thousands of acre-feet that covers the 2027 fields' headgate requirement in 24 of the 30 replayed weather years, with every replay started from each field's root zone as it stands at the end of 31 January 2027, rebuilt from the water its 2026 sets delivered.

world.org_type: irrigation district (a California special district) taking surface water from a regional conveyance project

driver: A forward requirement replayed over past driver traces starts every trace from the store each unit holds at the forecast date, and that store has to be rebuilt by running each unit's recorded replenishments through the season from the last time the record shows it full, because units run at a working deficit are replenished by about what they used and never return to full: taking each unit's last recorded replenishment as a refill, starting every trace full or spinning the model up on its own refill rule each leaves out the deficit the operation carried into the off-season.
driver_concrete: The Water Order Procedure starts every replay from each field's root zone as it stands at the end of 31 January 2027; the 501 drip, micro-sprinkler and sprinkler fields were held at a working deficit through 2026, each set putting back about what the crop had used, so after the spring none returned to field capacity and each ended its last set 0.48 to 3.99 inches short; only running each field's 2026 season through the balance at the water its delivered sets put in (ordered flow for the hours each ran, at the field's application efficiency) from the wet winter's field capacity finds that deficit, which adds 6,258 acre-feet to the 24th replay and moves the order from 209,000 to 215,000; taking each field's last set as a refill, starting full, or spinning up on the replays' own irrigation rule each leaves it out.
stump: A competent solver starts every replay from each field's root zone at the end of 31 January 2027 as the procedure files it, takes each field's last delivered 2026 set as a refill to field capacity, carries it through the record's dry October to January and files 209,000 acre-feet; the step that lands it there is not running each field's 2026 season through the balance at the water its delivered sets put in, from the wet winter's field capacity, which shows the 501 drip, micro-sprinkler and sprinkler fields ended the season short of field capacity after their last sets: the golden is 215,000 acre-feet.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads the procedure and every file correctly, assembles the 631 fields of the accepted 2027 requests, splices the weather record, builds each field's root zone at the end of 31 January 2027 from its last delivered 2026 set taken as a refill (an irrigation returns the root zone to field capacity in the procedure's own model) carried through the observed autumn and winter, replays the thirty weather years and applies the loss allowances files 209,000 acre-feet, six bins under the 215,000 the 2026 record supports; starting full files 196,000, each year's own winter 199,000 and the replays' irrigation rule run through 2026 199,000.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a season's irrigation requirement from a daily root-zone water balance (crop coefficients on reference evapotranspiration, allowable depletion, rain beyond field capacity draining, application efficiency), forecast as an ensemble of past weather traces from the soil water each field holds at the order date, which an irrigation hydrologist rebuilds by running the season's applied water through the same balance; with another field's nouns there is no root zone, field capacity, working deficit or application efficiency for the start state to live in.

differentiation.task446: task446 v2 chooses which screening rate carries across years (the error rates, not the yield) under a filed leave-one-cohort-out test; here nothing is selected by a test: the forecast's start state is rebuilt by running the season's delivered water through the field's own balance, against taking the last set as a refill.
differentiation.task137: task137 conditions a deposit's chance of the long call on its repricing gap and carries that share to the next maturity round (pattern E, G14, composition mix); here nothing is a share and no mix is reweighted: each field's root zone at the order date is rebuilt from the water its 2026 sets put in; the two share only a gap axis and a quantity answer.
differentiation.task138: Round 1 of this slot started each replay from the depletion carried from each field's last 2026 set taken as a refill through the winter; that start is now the default path and files the wrong order: the decisive step here is running the 2026 record at the water each set put in from the wet winter's field capacity, which shows the drip, micro-sprinkler and sprinkler fields never returned to field capacity after the spring.
differentiation.task126: task126 splits work records the natural build has chained through a succession link, read off a separate credit ledger, to measure a duration; here no record is split, joined or reattributed: every set is already on its field, and its delivered water is run through a daily soil-water balance to rebuild a state at the forecast date instead of taking the last set as a reset.
differentiation.task82: task82 attributes checkout records filed under one-off keys to members through a second system's ledger to count holders over a threshold; here nothing is attributed or counted: the forecast's start state is a quantity rebuilt by running each field's recorded deliveries through the season's balance.

lineage.driver: A forward requirement replayed over past driver traces has to start every trace from the store each unit actually holds at the forecast date, rebuilt from each unit's own last recorded replenishment and the observed drawdown since; starting every trace full, letting each trace inherit the store its own past year left, or rebuilding the store from the model's replenishment rule instead of the record each understates it, because most units were last replenished weeks before the rule would have replenished them and the interval since was dry.

notes: Round 2 (2026-10-14) within architecture v1: the start state is filed as an estimand (WOP 2.4, each field's root zone as it stands at the end of 31 January) and the decisive step moved to how that state is rebuilt. Calibration none: the delivery record and the lateral records are the district's own, not an organ confirming a filed criterion. Pattern none, decisive G3 (record against operation: the state is rebuilt from the delivered water, not from the model's rule that an irrigation refills) then G16 (method selection: the season forecast conditioned on that state). Stump strategy other: the forecast's start state rebuilt by running an operation's record of inputs through the season, against taking each unit's last recorded input as a reset (no listed family fits: no as-of date, grain, identity or rule decides). Gate G forecasting: the thirty past seasons, read correctly, do not pin the 2027 requirement without the state the record leaves. Forcing event season_or_peak: the order for the coming irrigation season is due by 1 February. Forum customer_or_counterparty: the order goes to the supplying project.
